name: Hollow Crypt
description: A decaying crypt with an ancient weathered map device and a single flickering campfire.

name: Awakened Foundry
description: Restored flagstones with glowing runic conduits. Awakens the Abyssal Resonator and Thaumaturgic Smelter.

name: Eldritch Sanctum
description: Cosmic astral rift cracks through the stone vault. Expands map queue and accelerates Thaumaturgic smelting.

name: Celestial Void
description: A gilded transcendent sanctum bathed in celestial radiance. Unlocks the 5th map slot and pinnacle relics.
